_comment: Mac + IBKR. Copy to config.json. broker is the only place the broker is named, and ibkr is this machine's; the launchers pass none. This template is dry on the paper port 7497, and mode dry stays dry. There is one 11:45 job either way; this file is the switch. Paper is mode paper, ibkr_port 7497, an account id starting with D, with TWS logged into paper. Real money is mode live, ibkr_port 7496 for TWS or 4001 for IB Gateway, broker_account set to the live id (it must not start with D), with TWS logged into the live account. ./run.sh paper and ./run.sh live override the mode for one launch.
_rules: Shared by both plans: 15m closes 12:00–1:00 PM ET, first qualifying bar, 1 spread. Width max(10, floor(EM/5)*5) where EM is the ATM straddle mid. Limit at mid. Skip if the marketable debit is more than $0.20 per side worse than mid. Flat 2 hours after the entry bar. No stop.
_plan: plan is the only trading rule that is a config key: A1 (the default, and what a missing key means) or B. A1, which this template ships on: take the day's first noon-window close beyond the prior day's high or low with no trigger bar, skip the day if any 15m close from 10:15 through 11:00 ET was already beyond those levels, long nearest 80 delta, and exit at +8 SPX points in the trade direction or the 2-hour flat, whichever comes first - no premium target. B, the alternative: a trigger close from 9:45 on and then a window close beyond it, long nearest 75 delta, GTC close at debit x 1.30. Nothing else differs, and there is no PLAN environment variable.
_wrap: Read-only log summary at 16:20 ET: python -m spx_noon wrap with no --book follows this file's mode, so an IBKR live config reads state/trades-live.csv and everything else reads state/trades.csv. --book paper and --book live pick one by hand. Neither sends orders. Client id 142 is reserved and unused by that job. After the markdown report it upserts one High Noon row on the shared Google Sheet; see _sheets.
_sheets: The 16:20 wrap's one daily row for Boi 'High Noon' on the sheet Candle and Fly already share. Columns, in order: Date, Boi, Traded, P&L after fees, Worst (always empty), What happened. The key is (Date, Boi), so a second wrap on the same date replaces the row. sheets_spreadsheet_id is the document id above and is not a secret. sheets_credentials is a path to the Google service-account key file; blank means <base_dir>/state/sheets-service-account.json. The key is never a key in this file: set SPX_SHEETS_CREDENTIALS_JSON (the whole json, kept in memory only), or SPX_SHEETS_CREDENTIALS or GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS to a path. Order: the json, then sheets_credentials, then those two variables, then the default path. The row goes on the Derek Comp tab, on this Mac and on Render. There is no tab setting. Install the client with pip install -e '.[sheets]'. A missing key or any sheet error leaves the markdown report in place, adds one status line, and still exits 0.
